board.description: Members' orders to this branch's kitchen, oldest first in each column.

noStore.title: This branch has no kitchen store
noStore.reason: {branch} has no warehouse set for its kitchen, so members can't order there and no order can be accepted.

reject.title: Reject order #{id}
reject.reasonRequired: Give a reason for the rejection.

history.description: Every order sent to a branch kitchen. Open a row to see the whole order.
history.cashReturn: Cash for an order not made

cashReturnState.credited_as_points: Credited to the member as points

stores.description: The warehouse each branch's kitchen draws from; its menu is what that warehouse holds. A branch with none takes no orders.
stores.warehousesUnavailable: Couldn't load the warehouses to choose from.

sticker.title: Ordering sticker
sticker.hint: Members scan this code to order from the kitchen.

reception.description: Orders from members with no session, waiting for you to check they are in the building. Confirm to send an order to the kitchen, or turn it down with a reason.
reception.loadError: Couldn't load the orders to confirm.
reception.confirmed: Order confirmed and sent to the kitchen.

confirmCash.currenciesFailed: Couldn't load the currency list; the base currency is chosen.
confirmCash.title: Confirm order #{id}
confirmCash.note: Take exactly what is due, in the currency you choose; the system works the amount out at today's rate. Change is given from the desk, never as points.

cashReturns.title: Cash to return
cashReturns.description: Members who paid cash for an order that was not made. Hand the cash back, or credit it as points if the member asks.

why.expired: Not confirmed in time, so it expired

returned.label: Returned in cash
returned.prompt: Have you handed {amount} back to the member?

credit.label: Credit as points
credit.prompt: Credit {points} points to the member's wallet instead of handing the cash back?
credit.done: Credited to the member as points.
